                    depth[to] = depth[v] + 1
                    q.append(to)
        self.depth = depth

import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long INF = (long)1e19;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;
    static final double EPS = 1e-10;

    static class Dinic {
        static final long INF = (long)1e18;
        int n;
        List<long[][]> links;
        int[] depth;
        int[] progress;
        List<int[]> pos;

        public Dinic(int n) {
            this.n = n;
            links = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                links.add(new long[0][3]);
            }
            pos = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        public Dinic copy() {
            Dinic res = new Dinic(this.n);
            for (int i = 0; i < this.links.size(); i++) {
                long[][] arr = this.links.get(i);
                long[][] copyArr = new long[arr.length][3];
                for (int j = 0; j < arr.length; j++) {
                    copyArr[j][0] = arr[j][0];
                    copyArr[j][1] = arr[j][1];
                    copyArr[j][2] = arr[j][2];
                }
                res.links.set(i, copyArr);
            }
            res.pos = new ArrayList<>(this.pos);
            return res;
        }

        public void addEdge(int from, int to, long cap) {
            pos.add(new int[]{from, links.get(from).length});
            links.set(from, append(links.get(from), new long[]{cap, to, links.get(to).length}));
            links.set(to, append(links.get(to), new long[]{0, from, links.get(from).length - 1}));
        }

        private long[][] append(long[][] arr, long[] val) {
            long[][] newArr = Arrays.copyOf(arr, arr.length + 1);
            newArr[arr.length] = val;
            return newArr;
        }

        public void bfs(int s) {
            depth = new int[n];
            Arrays.fill(depth, -1);
            depth[s] = 0;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int v = q.poll();
                for (long[] link : links.get(v)) {
                    long cap = link[0];
                    int to = (int) link[1];
                    if (cap > 0 && depth[to] < 0) {
                        depth[to] = depth[v] + 1;
                        q.offer(to);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        public long dfs(int v, int t, long flow) {
            if (v == t) return flow;
            int[] prog = progress;
            List<long[]> linksV = new ArrayList<>();
            for (long[] l : links.get(v)) {
                linksV.add(l);
            }
            for (int i = prog[v]; i < linksV.size(); i++) {
                prog[v] = i;
                long[] link = linksV.get(i);
                long cap = link[0];
                int to = (int) link[1];
                int rev = (int) link[2];
                if (cap == 0 || depth[v] >= depth[to]) continue;
                long d = dfs(to, t, Math.min(flow, cap));
                if (d == 0) continue;
                links.get(v)[i][0] -= d;
                links.get(to)[rev][0] += d;
                return d;
            }
            return 0;
        }

        public long flow(int s, int t) {
            long flow = 0;
            while (true) {
                bfs(s);
                if (depth[t] < 0) return flow;
                progress = new int[n];
                long currentFlow = dfs(s, t, INF);
                while (currentFlow > 0) {
                    flow += currentFlow;
                    currentFlow = dfs(s, t, INF);
                }
            }
        }

        public int[] getEdge(int i) {
            int[] p = pos.get(i);
            long[] e = links.get(p[0])[p[1]];
            long[] re = links.get((int) e[1])[ (int) e[2] ];
            return new int[]{p[0], (int) e[1], (int)(e[0] + re[0]), (int) re[0]};
        }

        public List<int[]> getEdges() {
            int M = pos.size();
            List<int[]> res = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
                res.add(getEdge(i));
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;

        int N = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        int M = 3;

        int[] A = new int[M];
        int[] B = new int[M];

        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
            A[i] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        }
        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
            B[i] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        }

        int ans1 = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
            ans1 += Math.min(A[i], B[(i + 1) % M]);
        }

        int ans2 = 0;
        Dinic dinic = new Dinic(2 * M + 2);
        int s = 2 * M;
        int t = 2 * M + 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
            // s to Alice
            dinic.addEdge(s, i, N);
            // Bob to t
            dinic.addEdge(M + i, t, B[i]);
            // draw
            dinic.addEdge(i, M + i, A[i]);
            // Alice lose
            dinic.addEdge(i, M + ((i - 1 + M) % M), A[i]);
        }

        long flowValue = dinic.flow(s, t);
        ans2 = N - (int) flowValue;

        System.out.println(ans2 + " " + ans1);
    }
}
